_about: Honest, append-only status history for Asaptic public endpoints. Seeded at launch from recorded browser-side probes; this file is not backed by server monitoring. Each entry records what a probe actually observed: state 'live' only when the endpoint returned parseable JSON, 'pending_rollout' when it returned the site shell (text/html) because the endpoint is not yet deployed.
